title: Build insect realism research mega pack
objective: Create a reproducible, licensed, deeply researched corpus and derived biology database for a 2-4 mm ant-first desktop overlay on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
acceptance_criteria: The research corpus records at least 2000 reviewed page-equivalents or equivalent primary-source depth without redistributing restricted material
Ant locomotion, gait, climbing, antenna motion, anatomy, behavior, trajectories, and screen-scale rendering are converted into provenance-backed implementation parameters
Open-source simulator/tracker/overlay candidates are audited for technical reuse and licensing
macOS, Windows, and Linux transparent click-through overlay constraints are documented
The final INSECT_REALISM_MEGA_PACK.zip is deterministic, indexed, license-audited, and reproducible
